text: Cloud infrastructure costs can be reduced by rightsizing compute instances, removing idle resources, and using reserved capacity for predictable workloads. Review usage metrics before purchasing commitments.
Autoscaling increases or decreases compute capacity based on demand. It can reduce waste during quiet periods while maintaining availability during traffic spikes.
A content delivery network caches static assets near users, reducing latency and origin server load. Application caches can reduce repeated database reads.
Protect data in transit with TLS and protect data at rest with encryption. Manage encryption keys with restricted access and rotation policies.
Backups enable recovery from accidental deletion and corruption. Define recovery point and recovery time objectives and test restores regularly.
Monitor request latency, error rates, throughput, and resource saturation. Alerts should be tied to user-impacting service-level objectives.
Object storage stores files as objects with metadata and keys. Versioning preserves previous versions; lifecycle policies can move older objects to lower-cost tiers.
BM25 uses lexical term matching. Dense vector retrieval finds semantically similar text. Hybrid retrieval combines these signals and reranking reorders candidates.
